evidence: app/src/routes/+page.svelte:45 — goto(url, { shallow: true, replace: true }) drives the home page's core filter/search UX; shallow routing became stable only in SvelteKit 3.0 (2026-10-01)
app/src/routes/+page.svelte:12 — page.shallow?.url ?? page.url, the docs-recommended pattern for the same newly-stable API
app/src/env.js:1 — defineEnvVars from @sveltejs/kit/env, stable since Kit 3.0 (experimental in 2.62+), used app-wide for API_BASE_URL
app/vite.config.js:7 — adapter configured in the sveltekit() Vite plugin, the Kit 3-required config location
reach.rationale: No experimental APIs at all, but two brand-newly-stable (weeks-old) API families — shallow routing and explicit env vars — sit in central places (home-page filtering, server API client). That is exactly 'recently-stable APIs in central places'.

evidence: app/src/routes/+page.svelte:12-45 — shallow routing is confined to this single route, with the docs' fallback pattern so a removal degrades gracefully
app/src/env.js:1-10 — env var definition isolated in one small module with a single consumer, app/src/lib/server/api.js:3
app/src/routes/+layout.svelte, app/src/routes/types/[name]/+page.svelte:1-6 — all other routes use only long-stable runes and conventions
containment.rationale: Each recently-stable API is isolated behind one file or one route; nothing is spread across the codebase, so a breaking change in either would touch at most two files.

evidence: app/src/routes/+page.svelte:34-45 — shallow navigation avoids rerunning the home-page load (full species list) on every debounced keystroke/filter change; a real performance win, and the documented use case

app/src/env.js:8 — static: false is deliberate: SPEC.md requires API_BASE_URL to be read at runtime (tests swap API data after build), which the legacy build-time-inlined $env/static/private could not do; $env/* is deprecated in Kit 3
app/package.json:5-6 — #lib subpath imports follow the Kit 3 migration guide rather than being gratuitous novelty
justification.rationale: Every newer API is either mandated by Kit 3 (env vars, vite-plugin config, #lib) or buys something a stable alternative couldn't (shallow routing avoids redundant load refetches per keystroke). Nothing is used for novelty.

findings.issue: Home-page filtering depends on shallow routing, which graduated from experimental to stable in SvelteKit 3.0 on 2026-10-01 — only weeks before today; semantics could still shift in early 3.x patch releases.
findings.suggestion: Pin the SvelteKit dependency (avoid broad ranges) and keep the existing page.shallow?.url ?? page.url fallback so reverting to plain goto is a one-line change if needed.

summary: The app targets the current stable release (SvelteKit 3.1.1, Svelte 5.57.3) and uses zero experimental flags or unstable APIs, but leans on two API families that graduated to stable only weeks ago — shallow routing (goto {shallow:true} / page.shallow) in the central home page, and the explicit defineEnvVars/$app/env/private system. Both uses are the framework-recommended pattern for Kit 3, well-isolated, and each buys something the stable alternatives couldn't (per-keystroke perf; runtime-read env vars per the spec). Risk is low: everything is contained to one or two files.
